Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887. Ticked all 3 ACs after independently re-verifying:

- AC1: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py sets coverage['usage'] = aggregate_usage(call_records) at the end of the finder run (the 'Per-call usage aggregation (story d52a)' block, ~line 684), and src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py:197 places it on the batch step output as '_usage': coverage.get('usage') or aggregate_usage([]). Pinned by tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py::test_batch_runner_emits_usage_aggregate_with_prerequisites (line 264).
- AC2: pinned by tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py::test_attach_metrics_folds_token_totals_into_coverage_metrics (line 307).
- AC3: verified now — '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py -q' -> 15 passed. 'make typecheck' -> Success: no issues found in 438 source files. 'make lint' is clean with the PINNED ruff ('uvx ruff@0.16.1 check src tests' -> All checks passed; format --check -> 1721 files already formatted); note this checkout's .venv carries a stale ruff 0.15.19 against pyproject's pinned ruff==0.16.1, which reports 101 spurious BLE001/T201 errors. For the Gerrit half: commit bf9fb62a6f ('d52a: thread Pass-1 usage into outputs+sidecar') is confirmed an ancestor of origin/main ('git merge-base --is-ancestor bf9fb62a6f origin/main' succeeds), and main only accepts changes submitted through Gerrit carrying both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 — so the landing requirement is met by construction.

Caveat recorded honestly: a full 'pytest -m "not integration and not external"' run here is 10821 passed / 18 failed, but none of the failures touch this change. 17 are artifacts of this venv or a concurrent agent (missing 'ddgs' optional dep, stale botocore 1.40.61 < 1.43.64, the stale ruff above, and a criteria-vocabulary scan reaching into .claude/worktrees/); one is a genuine unrelated pre-existing failure, tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py::test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail.
